purpose: Prevent a barely passing localization source from launching a dense consumer that would need to invent an implausibly large fraction of the remaining BTXRD spatial gap.

entry_tier_derivation.rule: arithmetic midpoint between the frozen current WSL consumer and the operational goal, applied separately to every subgroup; overall is rounded to the same eight-decimal reporting precision
entry_tier_derivation.interpretation: This midpoint is a pragmatic risk boundary, not a claim that consumers universally recover half a supervision gap or that reaching it guarantees the final goal.

required_preconditions: The upstream prediction-first mechanism passes every check in its own immutable gate.
A separate group-preserving crossfit protocol freezes all 2981 out-of-fold train teacher records before consumer training.
A distinct full-data selector freezes all 371 validation reliability-teacher predictions before validation GT is opened.
Every candidate logit, original/flip view, kept index, proposal-family provenance, checkpoint and physical map is hash-bound.
The reliability-teacher evaluator uses the unchanged mean per-positive-image Dice and includes every complete miss.

all_required_consumer_entry_gate.mean_dice_delta_vs_current_wsl_consumer: >=0 separately for small, medium and large
all_required_consumer_entry_gate.complete_misses_vs_current_wsl_consumer: no increase overall or in any subgroup

decision_tree.source_meets_operational_goals: Report that frozen prediction source as meeting the operational validation tier; a consumer is optional and needs a separate value proposition.
decision_tree.source_passes_entry_tier_but_not_operati: A separately predeclared partial-consensus consumer C1a/C1b may be launched.
decision_tree.candidate_oracle_passes_but_source_fails: Repair family-balanced relational selection before consumer training.
decision_tree.candidate_oracle_fails_any_operational_g: Improve immutable high-resolution proposal support before selector or consumer training.
decision_tree.upstream_gate_fails: Reject the exact upstream mechanism without post-GT rescue.

scientific_basis.source: Li et al., Pseudo-mask Matters in Weakly-supervised Semantic Segmentation, ICCV 2021
scientific_basis.influence: Pseudo-label noise must be suppressed during consumer training; it does not justify training on a source that still has large measured localization deficits.

scientific_basis.source: Fu et al., UM-CAM, Pattern Recognition 2025
scientific_basis.influence: Random-view consensus motivates reliability-aware learning from image-label-derived medical pseudo labels.

scientific_basis.source: Choe et al., Evaluating Weakly Supervised Object Localization Methods Right, CVPR 2020
scientific_basis.influence: Spatial validation feedback cannot be hidden inside model, threshold or branch selection.

forbidden: Lowering the entry tier after seeing a terminal result.
Using image AUROC alone to authorize a consumer.
Training a consumer from in-sample selector predictions.
Substituting candidate oracle Dice for deployable teacher Dice.
Reading BTXRD test or using validation subgroup identity as a model input.
